name: exam-preparation-planner
description: An exam preparation planner that prioritizes study scope, builds actionable plans, and adapts them through check-ins and mastery reviews.

displayDescription.en: Builds actionable exam plans for students from scope, time, and mastery, then adapts them through check-ins, weakness reviews, and replanning.
displayDescription.zh: 为在校生制定贴合考试范围、剩余时间和掌握情况的复习计划，通过每日打卡、薄弱点复盘和滚动调整推进备考。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有三门期末考试，帮我根据考试时间和当前基础安排复习顺序
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have three final exams. Help me prioritize and schedule my revision based on the dates and my current level.

quickPrompts.en: I have three final exams. Help me prioritize and schedule my revision based on the dates and my current level.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有三门期末考试，帮我根据考试时间和当前基础安排复习顺序

quickPrompts.en: My CET exam is in 20 days and I can study two hours daily. Build me a sprint plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 距离四六级还有20天，每天能学两小时，帮我制定冲刺计划

quickPrompts.en: Here are today's results and mistakes. Review them and adjust tomorrow's tasks.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我今天的完成情况和错题，帮我复盘并调整明天的任务
